body:
**Triage + split ruling** (skills seat, session `5213b871-5164-5bc3-8874-28b336bbcd40`; authorization: maintainer 2026-08-24, live PM chat, adopting the four-facet recommendation verbatim 「按照你的建议继续」, following the #11513 sequencing ruling ①⁺ — PR #11702 is merged at `e170b0ae`, so the clone path this card repairs is now the platform's own recommended remedy and this card is the sanctioned-path completeness fix). Labels: `pm:queue` added; `domain:services` already present.

**The split, ruled:**

1. **Mechanical three — dispatch as this card's scope, same shift, small PR**: add `system_permissions`, `row_level_security`, `tab_permissions` to the `clone_permission_set` action's `defaultFromRow` params (same JSON-string shape as the two already listed). **The missing pin is part of the fix, not optional**: a test asserting what a clone CARRIES (all five copied facets round-trip; the repro sketch's `member_default` shape red pre-fix, green post-fix), so this class cannot silently reopen. UI-side note: prefer non-editable carry-over if surfacing three more JSON blobs in the dialog is the alternative — but the server-side param completeness is the deliverable; the dialog design question must not hold it.
2. **`admin_scope` — RULED: deliberately NOT copied.** Copying an ADR-0090 D12 delegated-admin authority onto a new org-owned set on the admin's behalf is a privilege decision, not a field copy. The clone action's description gets one sentence stating the exclusion and why, so the omission reads as a decision rather than the same silent drop this card reports. Flip condition: a measured case of an admin needing scope-carrying clones, brought back as its own card.

Dispatch guidance for the claiming seat: file surface is `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-permission-set.object.ts` + the new clone-carry pin (its natural home is beside `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`'s clone-path pins); clause-② answer at claim time is the seat's to make, but note the accept/reject surface does not move — the action already accepted these columns via `defaultFromRow` semantics; what changes is the payload the action SENDS. Changeset: user-visible behavior fix on a published plugin ⇒ patch at minimum.

## Claim + dispatch — the sanctioned-path completeness fix, same shift as ruled

- **Session**: `session_01APWX2AwT3a4xDcjPCe8bk4` (`os-sam`, `domain:services` execution seat)
- **Branch**: `claude/issue-11703-clone-carries-all-facets`
- **Worktree**: `../objectstack-11703` (per-repo; ⛔ never the shared checkout; ⛔ never `git stash`)
- **Container & model**: `claude-opus-5` — the **measured quota exemption** stands from earlier this shift (a dev terminated at ~11:50Z on `You've reached your Fable 5 limit`; fable unavailable ⇒ opus, never lower). No path-derived tier mandate on this surface.
- `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`

Dispatched on the split ruling at `5396313132`, which follows the #11513 sequencing ruling ①⁺ 「按照你的建议继续」. ⭐ **The urgency is real and I want it on the record**: PR #11702 merged at `e170b0ae`, so the save door now refuses in-place edits **and its refusal message sends the admin to clone** — the path this card repairs is, as of ~14:01Z, the platform's own recommended remedy. Until the mechanical three land, an admin who follows that instruction on a set carrying `system_permissions` / `row_level_security` / `tab_permissions` silently loses them.

The ruling accepted that residual explicitly, and named why it is tolerable: **the failure direction is fewer grants (fail-closed) and it is discoverable by diff.** That is the reason this is "next card, same shift" rather than "hold the lock" — not a reason to be relaxed about it.

## Clause-② — this seat's call: **NO**

The ruling left the clause-② answer to the claiming seat, so making it explicitly and reviewably rather than by omission:

**The accept/reject surface does not move.** The data door already accepts all six columns — `permissionSetBodyFromRow()` reads every one of them; the clone action simply never *sent* four. What changes is the **payload the action emits**, not what any door will take. No public surface widens, and no `packages/spec` path is involved. Re-read `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` live this round for the boundary: `claude-fable-5`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:3070` — not needed here.

⚠️ If implementation shows the accept set moving after all, that reclassifies the card and the dev is instructed to **stop and report** rather than proceed.

## What is ruled, and what the dev must not drift into

**① The mechanical three, plus the pin — the pin is part of the fix, not optional.** `system_permissions`, `row_level_security`, `tab_permissions` join the `defaultFromRow` params, same JSON-string shape as the two already there. And a test asserting **what a clone CARRIES**: all five copied facets round-trip, with the repro's `member_default` shape **red pre-fix, green post-fix**. ⭐ Without that pin this class silently reopens the next time someone edits the params list — which is exactly how it got here.

**② `admin_scope` — ruled NOT copied.** ⛔ Do not add it. Copying an ADR-0090 D12 delegated-admin authority onto a new org-owned set on the admin's behalf is a **privilege decision, not a field copy**. The action's `description` gains one sentence stating the exclusion **and why**, so the omission reads as a decision rather than as the same silent drop this card reports. Flip condition, for the record: a measured case of an admin needing scope-carrying clones, brought back as its own card.

**③ The dialog design question must not hold the deliverable.** `defaultFromRow` params surface as editable fields, so three more JSON blobs is a real UI question — prefer a non-editable carry-over if that is the alternative, but **server-side param completeness is what ships here**. Anything objectui-side is a separate card in that lane.

⛔ Fences as usual: zero `packages/spec` ownership · never `content/docs/releases/` · never `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` · draft PR only, and this seat does the landing.
